summary: 3DNow! conditional 2-float vector normalize. Computes the packed length-squared of the input vector a1 (two packed halves), compares it against a tiny threshold constant 0x80000000800000 via pfcmpge, and branches: below/at threshold writes a packed {1.0, -1.0} fallback (0xBF8000003F800000) and zeroes the outputs, otherwise refines the reciprocal sqrt with a Newton step and writes normalized components to a2, plus a scaled component to a3 via SquareRootApproximation and the scale constant 0x4000000040000000. Returns the branch flag.

operations.description: Load the two packed float halves of input a1: first half at +0x0 into m64_u64 and second half at +0x8 into v4.
Compute packed per-lane squared components v5 = pfadd(pfmul(m64_u64, m64_u64), pfmul(v4, v4)).
Accumulate both lanes with pfacc to produce the packed length-squared value v6.
Take the packed reciprocal square root v7 = pfrsqrt(v6).
Compare length-squared v6 against the tiny threshold 0x80000000800000 (packet global VectorLengthSquaredThreshold 0x005AF970) with pfcmpge; a true result selects the fallback branch.
Fallback branch: write the fallback output only when a2 is non-null.
Fallback branch: write the packed constant 0xBF8000003F800000 (packet global SSEZeroThreshold 0x005AF8F0, {1.0, -1.0}) to a2 and zero the following dword.
Fallback branch: write zero to a3 only when a3 is non-null.
Fallback branch: clear a3 to zero.
Normalize branch: refine the reciprocal length with the Newton step pfrsqit1(pfmul(v7, v7), v6) then pfrcpit2, producing v11.
Normalize branch: write normalized components only when a2 is non-null.
Normalize branch: write the normalized packed vector to a2, first half m64_u64 * v11 and second half v11 * v4 at a2 + 8.
Normalize branch: when a3 is non-null, invoke the reciprocal-sqrt approximation helper.
Normalize branch: write the scaled component to a3 = punpckhdq(v4, v4) * 0x4000000040000000 (packet global OutputLengthScale 0x005AF908).
Emit the 3DNow! femms state-clear and return the branch result.
